Note.title: Note
Note.description: A user-owned cloud-synced rich text note with category, stationery color tint, and pin status.

title.description: Note heading (0 to 120 characters; either title or content must be non-empty).

content.description: Note body text (0 to 10000 characters; either title or content must be non-empty).

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top of the workspace.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

TaskList.title: TaskList
TaskList.description: A user-owned task list folder grouping related checklist items.

name.description: Display name of the task list (1 to 60 characters).

colorKey.description: Accent color token key for the list.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: An individual checklist task belonging to a user's TaskList.

listId.description: Document ID of the parent TaskList under /users/{userId}/taskLists/{listId}.

completed.description: Whether the task has been completed.

dueDateEpochDay.description: Optional due date stored as UTC epoch day (0 to 100000); omitted when unset.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Private cloud-synced notes belonging to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/taskLists/{listId}.description: Private cloud-synced task lists belonging to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Private cloud-synced tasks belonging to the authenticated user and linked to a TaskList.
